goal: I want more creators signing up this month.

steps.title: A shorter sign-up form
steps.why: Sign-up makes a student on a phone type 9 required fields, including GST, bank account and full address, before they have seen a single deal, while the terms only need PAN before the first payout.
steps.seen: signup.html: 9 required fields (name 'as on PAN', email, phone, Instagram, PAN, GST, bank account, IFSC, postal address) and the button says 'Submit registration'. terms.html: 'Creators are paid within 7 days of a brand approving their content. PAN is required before the first payout.'
steps.build: In signup.html, keep only these fields: name (relabel as 'Your name'), email, phone (add type="tel" and inputmode="numeric"), and Instagram handle (add placeholder "@yourhandle"). Remove the pan, gst, account, ifsc and address inputs. Keep form action="dashboard.html". Change the h1 to 'Join as a creator, it's free', add one line under it: 'Takes 1 minute. We ask for PAN and bank details only when you get your first payout.' Change the button text to 'Join and see deals'. Leave the other pages alone. In test_pages.py, keep the existing tests and add test_signup_is_short: it checks signup.html has at most 4 '<input', and contains none of name="gst", name="pan", name="account", name="ifsc", name="address".
steps.decide: Do creators ever need a GST number for Sunny Shop deals, or can we stop asking for it altogether?
options: Ask only above a yearly earnings level

steps.title: A home page that speaks to creators
steps.why: The home page talks about 'a platform' and 'the future of commerce' and has a section for brands but none for creators, so a creator never sees the real deals (₹1,500 to ₹3,000) or a clear button to join.
steps.seen: index.html: the copy is general ('Sunny Shop is a platform… deliver value'), there is a 'Brands' section with a sales email, and the only creator link is 'Creator sign-up' in the 12px grey footer. deals.html: real deals such as Chai Co 2 reels ₹3,000, Kurta House 1 post ₹1,500, FitBottle 3 stories ₹
steps.build: In index.html, put a creator section at the top of <main>, above the current text: h1 'Get paid by Indian brands for your Instagram posts', a line 'Free to join. Paid within 7 days of the brand approving your post.' (wording from terms.html), then a short list of the 3 deals copied from deals.html (brand, what to post, ₹ amount), and a large full-width link to signup.html with the text 'Join as a creator'. If he approves, add the earnings line from his answer below. Move 'About us' and 'Brands' below this section and keep their text. Keep the footer link. In style.css add a .cta class for the link (display:block; text-align:center; background #f59e0b; color #fff; padding 14px; border-radius 6px; font-weight bold; text-decoration none) so it is easy to tap on a phone. Add test_home_invites_creators to test_pages.py: index.html contains 'href="signup.html"' at least twice and contains '₹3,000'.
steps.decide: Can the home page say that creators earn about ₹8,000 a month in their first 3 months?
options: Yes, show '₹8,000 a month on average'
No, show only the deal amounts

steps.title: Make the ₹500 invite reward easy to see
steps.why: The ₹500 reward for both creators is the best reason to bring a friend, but it is hidden in small grey text 400px below the button, and no page links to the invite page, so new creators never find it.
steps.seen: invite.html: the heading is just 'Invite', the text says 'You can invite other creators.', and 'Rewards: when an invited creator finishes their first deal, you both get ₹500.' sits in 12px #999 text with margin-top:400px. dashboard.html (where sign-up lands) shows only 'No data.' and links nowhere.
steps.build: In invite.html, change the h1 to 'Invite a friend, you both get ₹500' and put the reward sentence in normal-size text right above the 'Copy invite link' button. Remove the inline style with margin-top:400px. In dashboard.html, replace 'No data.' with a short welcome: 'You're in! Here's what to do next:' and two full-width links: 'See open deals' → deals.html and 'Invite a friend, you both get ₹500' → invite.html (reuse the .cta class from the home page step, or add it to style.css if it isn't there yet). Keep test_invite_reward_is_500. Add test_invite_reward_visible: in invite.html the index of '₹500' comes before the index of '<button' and 'margin-top:400px' is gone. Add test_dashboard_links_next_steps: dashboard.html contains 'deals.html' and 'invite.html'.

answers: Yes, show '₹8,000 a month on average'

check: 9 tests, all passing. All 5 that passed before still pass.
